title: Recruiting Botan

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Broken hover board? Throw it in the back. Twenty Lims for a reset, fifty for a new rear grav-fan, a hundred for anything else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Broken hover board? Throw it in the back. Twenty Lims for a reset, fifty for a new rear grav-fan, a hundred for anything else.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Well, if you're here about a boat you can keep walking. I don’t do boats.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, if you're here about a boat you can keep walking. I don’t do boats.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: HOVAs. All kinds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: HOVAs. All kinds.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Think I don’t fucking know that? This air stinks of sea breeze. Not even a fucking sniff of chem trail. Makes me fucking sick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Think I don’t fucking know that? This air stinks of sea breeze. Not even a fucking sniff of chem trail. Makes me fucking sick.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Who the fuck are you, ‘Sec? Are you fucking ‘Sec?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who the fuck are you, ‘Sec? Are you fucking ‘Sec?

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Mmfh. Going out of my mind here. It’s all that water. No Vincs, no parking lots, no lanes, no Grid... ugh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mmfh. Going out of my mind here. It’s all that water. No Vincs, no parking lots, no lanes, no Grid... ugh.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Papers. I don’t got papers. Without them I can’t get back in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Papers. I don’t got papers. Without them I can’t get back in.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Sigh. Got called out here to work on an engine. A Viathan-80. Hundred years old if it was a day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sigh. Got called out here to work on an engine. A Viathan-80. Hundred years old if it was a day.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: What? Yeah. Had to submit a works order to CorpSec’s local competitiveness bureau, only when I come to leave this steel shit heap...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Yeah. Had to submit a works order to CorpSec’s local competitiveness bureau, only when I come to leave this steel shit heap...

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Fucking system changed overnight. Papers got shredded, I got stuck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fucking system changed overnight. Papers got shredded, I got stuck.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: They repossessed my HOVA collection too. Even Valkerie!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They repossessed my HOVA collection too. Even Valkerie!

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Coming up two years now. Lost my shop back in Industrial cos I didn’t have an official district presence. They repossessed my HOVA collection too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Coming up two years now. Lost my shop back in Industrial cos I didn’t have an official district presence. They repossessed my HOVA collection too.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: My HOVA. HaloPulse Mark IV. Lowtown Lime with a carmine under-shimmer. Best vat-grown leather seats money could buy. And the engine…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My HOVA. HaloPulse Mark IV. Lowtown Lime with a carmine under-shimmer. Best vat-grown leather seats money could buy. And the engine…

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Stupid fucking boards are the closest thing to a HOVA as I can get out here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stupid fucking boards are the closest thing to a HOVA as I can get out here.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: And why the fuck would you do that for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And why the fuck would you do that for me?

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Here we go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here we go.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: O.R.S? Not the thing run by that circumlocutious hack Cherry?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: O.R.S? Not the thing run by that circumlocutious hack Cherry?

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: I’ve read what he calls “poetry”. He wouldn’t know free verse if it ran over his foot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’ve read what he calls “poetry”. He wouldn’t know free verse if it ran over his foot.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Fine. But we made a fucking deal here. Remember that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. But we made a fucking deal here. Remember that.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Then what do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Ideas? What kind of ideas? Sounds like I don't like your ideas.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ideas? What kind of ideas? Sounds like I don't like your ideas.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Timewaster.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Timewaster.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: I had to get my entire arm into the foul line before it would inject right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I had to get my entire arm into the foul line before it would inject right.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Course, the Viathan-90s solved that problem by bypassing the fucking overspill sump with-–

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Course, the Viathan-90s solved that problem by bypassing the fucking overspill sump with-–

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Tried to. Got deported back here. Anyway, there's no point. Lost my shop back in Industrial cos I didn’t have an official district presence.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tried to. Got deported back here. Anyway, there's no point. Lost my shop back in Industrial cos I didn’t have an official district presence.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Even Valkerie!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Even Valkerie!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’m not here about a board.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m not here about a board.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I’m not here about a board.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I’m not here about a board.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Haven't seen many HOVAs round here...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haven't seen many HOVAs round here...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Haven't seen many HOVAs round here...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Haven't seen many HOVAs round here...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you don’t like it then why are you here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you don’t like it then why are you here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you don’t like it then why are you here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you don’t like it then why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck no!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck no!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don't you go back to the mainland?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don't you go back to the mainland?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why don't you go back to the mainland?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why don't you go back to the mainland?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Too bad. I gotta get going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Too bad. I gotta get going.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Too bad. I gotta get going.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Too bad. I gotta get going.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How come?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How come?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: About the papers...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About the papers...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lemme guess, no papers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lemme guess, no papers.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not just sneak back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not just sneak back?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When did this happen?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When did this happen?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Valkerie?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Valkerie?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're stuck fixing hover boards.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're stuck fixing hover boards.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you're stuck fixing hover boards.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you're stuck fixing hover boards.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know some people inside CorpSec. Maybe I can look into your papers for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know some people inside CorpSec. Maybe I can look into your papers for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know some people inside CorpSec. Maybe I can look into your papers for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know some people inside CorpSec. Maybe I can look into your papers for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know some people who could help. Maybe I could look into getting those papers for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know some people who could help. Maybe I could look into getting those papers for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know some people who could help. Maybe I could look into getting those papers for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know some people who could help. Maybe I could look into getting those papers for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’d want a favor in exchange...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’d want a favor in exchange...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I’d want a favor in exchange...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I’d want a favor in exchange...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go to an O.R.S. meeting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go to an O.R.S. meeting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not my problem I'm afraid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not my problem I'm afraid.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You know him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. Will you go?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Will you go?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But will you go?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But will you go?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hello to you as well.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello to you as well.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No worries. No boats.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No worries. No boats.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm trading ideas.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm trading ideas.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you should think about a change.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you should think about a change.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you should think about a change.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you should think about a change.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Errr ....

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Errr ....

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What ....

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What ....

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bureaucracy...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bureaucracy...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because you will do something for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because you will do something for me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Because you will do something for me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Because you will do something for me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need you to go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need you to go.
